desc: Constructed of stainless steel or titanium, Daniel SoundGuard Powered by KGM Suppressor 1.375-24 HUB direct-thread adapters are available in in ½ - 28” and 5/8 - 24” TPI and provide rock-solid mounting and rapid attachment/detachment. They utilize a non-proprietary flat wrench (included) that attaches or removes the adapter to the suppressor tube or an appropriately threaded firearm muzzle in seconds—no additional or special tools necessary! Because no mounting adapters or other mounting hardware is required, these direct-thread adapters allow the suppressors to be conveniently and easily switched from one firearm to another compatible-caliber firearm with an appropriately threaded muzzle.
